title: Mon Calamari Star Cruiser
caption: Mon Calamari Star Cruiser (V)
game_text: For each Imperial starship on table, deploys -1 (to a minimum of 3). May add 5 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 3 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. [Ship-docking]
lore: Mon Cal MC80 cruiser. Originally a civilian ship. Converted to military use following the liberation of Mon Calamari from the Empire.

Icon column top to bottom: yellow pilot helmet (permanent pilot, 'Permanent pilot provides ability of 2') → permanent-pilot, red box with R2 dome → nav. '[Ship-docking]' as printed.
